We build guitar effects by hand in the quaint landlocked city of Akron, Ohio. Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Menu EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch Spires Rosac Nu-Fuzz and the discontinued EQD Dream Crusher™ in one enclosure THIS DEVICE IS NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION   Spires™ Fuzz Doubler The Spires was born from my need to have my big old Rosac Nu Fuzz and our now discontinued Dream Crusher on my pedalboard without taking up all the space. The Green channel features a cranked fuzz inspired by the Rosac Electronic Nu-Fuzz, which, for all the unacquainted fuzz seekers, was released in 1968- decades prior to the dreaded “nü” prefix ever being uttered. The original schematic for Rosac Nu Fuzz is somewhat of a mystery so I used my original to make a “sonic copy” that is pretty much dead on. It is full-on fuzz all the time and uses crude wide range Tone control to change the character from big and warm to sizzling and blown out. The original was slightly below unity at max so I gave this one plenty of output volume while retaining the original tone. The Red channel is a silicon version of the now discontinued Dream Crusher. There’s no need to mourn the loss anymore. Dreams will still be crushed with walls of classic two transistor fuzz; only this time, the crushing will be much more stable and less temperature sensitive. It features a very usable, dynamic Fuzz control and tons of output volume, just like the original. Controls     Green Controls 1. Tone: Changes the tonal character of the fuzz. Darker counterclockwise, brighter clockwise. 2. Green: Sets the output level when the green LED is lit. Red Controls 3. Fuzz: Adjusts the fuzz amount — dirtier clockwise, cleaner counterclockwise 4. Red: Sets the output level when the red LED is lit. Footswitches 5. Channel Switch: Selects between Red (Dream Crusher) and Green (Nu Fuzz) channels 6. Activate Switch: Turns the effect on and off Audio Samples GUITAR SAMPLES Red Right / Green Left Gibson Les Paul Green: Blown Out Gibson Les Paul Green: Neck To Bridge Gibson Les Paul Green: Shit Stomper Gibson Les Paul Red: Dial 'er Up Gibson Les Paul Red: Muscle Car Gibson Les Paul Red: Red Color Gibson Les Paul Red Fender Telecaster Green Fender Telecaster   SYNTH SAMPLES Red Rum Fender Rhodes Green Fuzz Blaster Fender Rhodes View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize Tech Specs Dimensions: 4.65 x 3.65 x 2.25 in. (118 x 93 x 57 mm) with knobs Current Draw: 44 mA Red Input Impedance: 100 kΩ Output Impedance: <10 kΩ Green Input Impedance: 200 kΩ Output Impedance: <10 kΩ Switching This device is true bypass and uses electronic relay-based switching. Audio will not pass without power. Power This device can be powered by a 9v battery or a standard 9-volt DC power supply with a 2.1mm negative center barrel. We always recommend pedal-specific, transformer-isolated wall-wart power supplies or multiple isolated-output supplies. Pedals will make extra noise if there is ripple or unclean power. Switching-type power supplies, daisy chains and non-pedal specific power supplies do not filter dirty power as well and let through unwanted noise. DO NOT RUN AT HIGHER VOLTAGES!
